data.one_liner: Convenient code generator for get_it dependency injection.
data.what_it_does: Injectable automates the wiring and registration of services for get_it using annotations like @injectable, @singleton, and @module. It analyzes your classes and generates an initialization extension method for your GetIt instance.
use_when: You are using get_it for dependency injection in your Flutter or Dart application
You want to eliminate boilerplate code for registering factories and singletons
avoid_when: You prefer manual service registration without code generation tools
strengths: Reduces boilerplate associated with get_it registrations
Supports asynchronous initialization, singletons, factories, and factory parameters
weaknesses: Requires running a code generator (build_runner or lean_builder)
Adds an extra build step during development
data.setup_notes: Add injectable and get_it to dependencies, and injectable_generator and build_runner (or lean_builder) to dev_dependencies. Create a configuration function annotated with @InjectableInit and run the generator.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer manual service registration without using a code generator.
